messages.label: Messages
messages.queuedHint: Waiting for the session to be at its prompt

queuedWhy.turn: Queued: the agent is busy, sends when its turn ends
queuedWhy.dialog: Queued: waiting on a dialog in the session
queuedWhy.prompt: Queued: waiting for the session prompt
queuedWhy.draft: Waiting: the input box has unsent text
queuedWhy.input: Queued: the session is still taking earlier input
queuedWhy.noinput: Queued: this session does not take chat input
queuedWhy.midturn: Queued: this agent can't take input mid-turn, sends when its turn ends

delivery.queued: Queued on {who}, waiting for the agent
delivery.sendTimeout: Not delivered: no confirmation within 30 seconds. It may not have been sent, retry is safe
delivery.resendHint: The first copy may still arrive

messages.speakFailed: Could not read this message aloud
messages.voiceOnDevice: Speech is generated on this device
messages.emptySession: Shows the agent's replies from the moment the runner started following this session. Earlier history and your own prompts stay in the terminal.

composer.placeholder: Message the Manager, or type / for commands
composer.placeholderSession: Instruct {agent} (it will act), or type / for its commands

search.privacy: Searched on this device. Messages are decrypted here and the index never leaves it.

join.title: Approve a new device?
join.body: A new device wants to read your chats. Only approve it if you just set it up yourself.
join.compare: Compare this fingerprint with the one shown on the other device. If they differ, reject.

revoke.effect: That device will stop receiving your chats and can never be trusted again.
revoke.cascade: Devices that were only introduced by it will also drop out and need to be approved again.

confirmKind.title: Confirm this device kind?
confirmKind.body: {kind} devices can send you owner messages and vouch for other devices. Only confirm it if you recognise this device and know what it is.
confirmKind.compare: Check the fingerprint on that device before you confirm.

reset.title: Reset chat identity?
reset.body: This device becomes the only trusted device for your chats.
reset.newKeys: This device gets new chat keys.
reset.rejoin: Every other device must join again.

devices.title: Chat devices
devices.hint: Devices that can read your chats.
devices.keyMismatch: The relay now reports different keys for a device you trust. That device is not used until you check it.
devices.joinCodeReused: A join request used a code that was already used, closed or expired. Nobody was added; open a new code if you did not expect this.
devices.roomConflict: A device claimed a chat room that already belongs to another device. Check your devices before trusting new messages.
devices.kindConflict: Your devices disagree about what kind of device one of them is. The most restricted kind is used. Check your devices.
devices.kindUnknown: A trusted device has no confirmed kind after an app update. It cannot send you owner messages or vouch for other devices until you confirm it as a desktop or phone.
devices.trustUnstable: The device list kept changing while it was being checked, so some devices are left out for now. Check your devices.
devices.rootKindUnknown: This device cannot confirm what kind of device it was joined through. Re-join this device with a fresh join code from a desktop or phone.
devices.alertOther: The relay raised a security alert ({kind}). Check your devices.
devices.waiting: Waiting for the other device to approve this one. Check its screen, or use a different code.
devices.joinedHint: This device already trusts other devices. Use Add device, or reset the chat identity to join a different group.

pair.showBody: On a phone that is not set up for chat yet, open Manager, Chat devices, then scan this code. You will approve the phone here. The code works once and expires in 10 minutes.
pair.expired: The code expired and can no longer be used. Show a new code to add a device.
pair.errorNotSetUp: Chat sync is not ready on this computer yet. Make sure you are signed in, then try again.
pair.errorNotApproved: This computer is not approved for chat yet. Approve it from one of your trusted devices first, then try again.
pair.errorGeneric: Could not create a pairing code: {error}
pair.enterBody: On your phone open Manager, Chat devices, then Show join code, and paste it here. This works only while this device has no other trusted devices.

panel.writeToAct: To make it act, write in its chat.
panel.handoff: Hand off to a fresh session
panel.handoffHint: Context is above 180k. Ask the Manager to hand this work off to a fresh session.
panel.pickSession: Select a session to see its details.
panel.auditHint: Every manager action is logged on this device.
panel.serverSeesBody: Encrypted blobs it cannot read, when messages are sent and their size, and which paired devices exchange them. It never sees message text or session names.
panel.providerSeesBody: The Manager is an AI agent. The provider that runs it does see the text the Manager processes, including session output it reads for you.

hierarchy.mainDuty: asks you to approve risky actions
hierarchy.subDuty: takes orders from the main Manager

newSession.title: New session
newSession.name: Name
newSession.noSandboxHint: The session can touch anything your user can
newSession.bypassHint: No confirmation before edits or commands

switchAgent.title: Switch agent
switchAgent.cliNote: {agent} sessions are managed from the tmgr CLI by design.
switchAgent.historyStays: Chat history stays. It lives in TMGR, not in the agent.
switchAgent.handoff: The new agent gets a handoff packet with the goal and a summary of the last messages.

control.forceBody: The agent process is killed immediately and cannot save its work. Use this only when Stop does not work.
control.deleteBody: This removes the session entry from the runner. It cannot be undone.
control.stillRunning: This chat is still running. Use Force stop.
control.busyHint: Working... please wait for it to finish.

mention.unrestricted: Not available for unrestricted sessions yet

state.queued: Queued, waiting for {who} to be free
state.rate_limited: Too many mentions, wait a minute

confirm.sendBody: The target runs in bypass or no-sandbox mode. Your question will be typed into it and it can act without asking.
confirm.injectTitle: Add this reply to the context?
confirm.injectBody: The reply is text from another chat. It will be added to this chat as data, but this chat runs without the usual safeguards.

voice.title: External voice
voice.intro: Read messages aloud with a speech server or program you run yourself.
voice.remoteWarning: Chat text will be sent to this server
voice.emptyArgumentsNote: Empty arguments are removed when you save.
voice.timeoutInvalid: Timeout must be a whole number from 1 to 120.
voice.commandNote: The text is passed on standard input; the program must write a WAV file to standard output.
voice.testPhraseDefault: This is a test of the external voice.
voice.testNote: Test uses saved settings. Save your changes first.
voice.sileroHint: See docs/tts-external.md in the TMGR repository for running Silero as a local server.

presence.title: Touch ID approvals
presence.body: Answer dangerous permission requests on this Mac after Touch ID. One check covers answers for 10 minutes; sleep or a locked screen ends it.
presence.setupAgain: The Touch ID key stopped working. Set it up again.
presence.resend: Send the key to runners again
presence.approve: On each runner machine, approve the key once:
